utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can keep an eye out for any updates and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that right? Can you confirm who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can’t confirm that for sure yet, but I’ll ask around and see who’s coordinating it. If I hear back, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass it along and keep folks posted about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. I might miss the updates, so just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep you in the loop if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a few basic tools and help sort donations when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring basic tools and help sort the donations when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, and I’m glad to help where I can. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we could use any spare screws, tape, and a couple of screwdrivers if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring those by later today — I’ve got some spare screws and tape, and I’ll check for a couple of screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times, so let me know what the repair drive needs from us.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be wonderful, Faye — thank you. I’ll send you the pickup and drop-off needs so you can help keep everything moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send them over when you can, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just tell me the plan and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, right—let’s keep it simple: I’ll bring the tools, and you help me sort the donations. Then we’ll head over together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll sort the donations and be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, we’re doing a little repair drive in the neighborhood—if you’re free, I’d love for you to join us.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might be able to help, but I’d need to know the time, place, and what kind of repairs you’re expecting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re meeting Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and mostly doing small fixes like loose hinges, squeaky doors, and a few patch-up jobs. If that works, I’d be thrilled to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized—what’s the latest on where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re setting up drop-off at the community center porch on Saturday morning. If it’s bulky, just text me and we’ll arrange pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll spread the word about Saturday morning at the community center porch. If I hear of any bulky items, I’ll text you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help, but I want to make sure I have the details right—what’s the repair drive for, and when do you need it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s for fixing up the shared tools and a few items folks have been meaning to repair, and I’d love to have everything ready by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—shared tools and a few repairs, ready by Saturday afternoon. I’ll check what’s needed and help make a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still trying to sort out a few things on my end, but I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’m a bit behind as usual, but I can help where I can. What’s the biggest thing you still need sorted for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just a clear list of what’s still missing and who can cover each part. If you’ve got that, I can help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — do you have a hammer and a screwdriver I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — I can bring them by whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—what’s the repair drive location you want me to track?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh—just the one by Maple Street, near the community center. Thanks for tracking it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll mark the repair drive by Maple Street near the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Rey—just give me a shout if something comes up. I’ve got a few tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the timing and drop-off spot first? I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got it straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I just need the exact time and the drop-off location, and then I can confirm whether I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good turnout for the repair drive—I'm happy to help connect folks if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules—thank you. I’ll take you up on it and let you know who could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—just send me the names and what they need, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a decent stock of supplies for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably joining a bit late, but I can still bring whatever you’re short on. What’s the biggest gap right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re shortest on duct tape, gloves, and a couple of flashlights. If you can grab any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I’m planning to swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear. I’ll check the school pickup time and see if I can bring by a few extra things later too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely — I bet they could still use cleaning supplies or heavy-duty tape. If you find out the pickup time, just let me know and I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’m in—just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the repair drive details now. It’s the easiest way to see what’s needed and where you can help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, send it my way and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort the donated items and set them by type?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated items and set them by type.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or pass along details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, pass along the details—I’m still catching up on what’s happening, but I’d like to help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at the community hall, and folks are bringing anything that needs a quick fix. I’ll send you the full details and you can jump in wherever you’re comfortable.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can keep an eye on where it’s happening and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal — that’d help a lot. Please let me know where it’s set up, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll watch for it and tell you as soon as I spot the setup location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I think so, but let me double-check the details first and then I’ll confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — can you let me know as soon as you confirm?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. I’m hoping we can get a few more folks to chip in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do that. If I hear anyone around the block who might help, I’ll point them your way.
